findings.summary: `docs/project-status.md` states the allowlist bound as 'at most 64 entries per selector' while the shipped bound is 32.
findings.detail: The Phase 12 'Next tasks' paragraph added by the attempt-2 reconciliation (`docs/project-status.md` lines 707-708) reads 'Task 12.1 defines the bounded per-selector allowlist (at most 64 entries per selector, each at most 64 characters ...)'. The shipped bound is at most 32 entries per selector: `BadgeDefinition.MaximumAllowedValues = 32` (`src/ArrTags/Rendering/BadgeDefinition.cs:36`), enforced by `RendererConfiguration.Validate` (`src/ArrTags/Configuration/RendererConfiguration.cs:160`). ADR-017 clause 5 (`docs/decisions.md:2231`), `docs/architecture.md:1195`, `docs/data-model.md:469/890`, `PLANS.md:4509/4537`, and the settings page `src/ArrTags/Configuration/config.html:82` all consistently state 32. `docs/project-status.md:708` is therefore the sole surface with the wrong number, and it is a canonical current-state surface that this correction round was specifically required to make accurate. It is a documentation defect only and does not affect the task 12.2 acceptance criteria or any functional behavior. Introduced by attempt 2 (HEAD has no Phase 12 Next-tasks bullet; the attempt-2 worker report states it 'adds a Phase 12 item to the Next tasks list').

findings.summary: `IsAllowed` trims the candidate but not the supplied allowlist entries; the production path is correct because `BadgeDefinition` trims every entry at construction.
findings.detail: `BadgeSelectorResolver.IsAllowed` trims only the candidate value and compares against `allowedValues` verbatim. ADR-017 clause 2 trims the comparison value and clause 5 trims the configured entries; the resolved allowlist reaching the renderer is always `BadgeDefinition.AllowedValues`, built by `NormalizeAllowedValues` (which trims and copies each entry). `RendererConfigurationResolver.ResolveDefinitions` constructs `BadgeDefinition` from the persisted entries, so the only production caller is guaranteed trimmed entries. A direct external caller passing untrimmed entries would not match, but no such caller exists. Carries forward from attempt 1 unchanged.
findings.recommended_action: None required; optionally document in the `IsAllowed` XML comment that entries are expected to be pre-trimmed, or trim defensively.

acceptance_criteria_assessment.a_configured_allowlist_restricts_renderi: MET. `BadgeDefinitionResolver.Resolve` filters each resolved pre-template `value.Text` through `BadgeSelectorResolver.IsAllowed(value.Text, definition.AllowedValues)` before applying the template. Tests `AllowlistRequiresAnExactCaseInsensitiveMatch`, `CustomBadgeAllowlistAppliesPerRetainedValue`, `AudioAllowlistMatchesTheFullComposite`, `UpgradePendingAllowlistPermitsTheFixedStatusText`, and `FilterIsAppliedBeforeTheDefinitionTemplate` assert retention and suppression. The attempt-1 mutation run (forcing `IsAllowed` to always allow) failed 6 of 8 allowlist facts, confirming non-vacuousness.
acceptance_criteria_assessment.unknown_and_absent_values_remain_omitted: MET. Unknown/absent values are never emitted by `BadgeSelectorResolver.Resolve`, and `IsAllowed` only removes already-confirmed values (empty allowlist returns true; non-empty only matches present text). `UnknownAndAbsentValuesRemainOmittedWithAnAllowlist` asserts an empty selection even with a non-empty allowlist. The filter cannot widen an omission.
acceptance_criteria_assessment.an_empty_allowlist_means_no_restriction: MET. `IsAllowed` returns true immediately when `allowedValues.Count == 0`; `BadgeDefinition` normalizes null/empty to an empty read-only list. `IsAllowedTrimsTheResolvedValueAndRejectsPartialMatches` and `EmptyAllowlistMeansNoRestriction` assert the behavior; `BadgeDefinition.V1Default` carries empty allowlists.
acceptance_criteria_assessment.match_semantics_exact_case_insensitive_o: MET. `string.Equals(candidate, allowed, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)` after `value.Trim()`; configured entries are trimmed by `BadgeDefinition.NormalizeAllowedValues`. No substring/prefix/wildcard/regex path exists (`BadgeAllowlistFilterTests` asserts `Bluray`, `1080p`, `Bluray-1080p-extra`, `Bluray*` are all filtered, and `  Bluray-1080p  ` matches).
acceptance_criteria_assessment.filter_before_template_order: MET. The filter uses the pre-template value (`value.Text`); `FilterIsAppliedBeforeTheDefinitionTemplate` shows an allowlist naming the templated text (`Q:Bluray-1080p`) filters the value out while an allowlist naming the pre-template value retains it and then applies the template.
acceptance_criteria_assessment.per_custom_value_and_full_audio_composit: MET. `BadgeSelectorResolver.Resolve` emits one `BadgeValue` per retained custom badge (filtered independently) and one full `Audio` composite (`Atmos/TrueHD/8`); a component alone (`TrueHD`, `Atmos`) does not match. The fixed `UpgradePending` status text is filtered and can be suppressed.
acceptance_criteria_assessment.allowlisted_but_unfittable_still_shorten: MET. The filter runs before `BadgeLayoutEngine.Build`; `AnAllowlistedValueThatCannotFitStillFollowsTheOmitBehavior` retains an allowlisted custom value and asserts the layout omits it because it cannot fit.
